entries.1056c0cc17dee8f6: Elderly people certified as requiring nursing care
entries.2f655ff2b6a6c833: Through consolidated subsidiary Kitayama Jutaku Hanbai Co., Ltd., this business designs, builds, and owns "Anjes" facilities. It enters into construction contracts with landowners, and also holds land and buildings it has acquired itself and leases them to the company. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥62 million.
entries.3f19947ec0ba8e5b: This business operates serviced housing for elderly people "Anjes" and provides home-visit care, visiting nursing, and in-home care support. The company is responsible for this business, and its sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥4,823 million. As of the end of December 2025, the company operates 36 facilities with 1,210 rooms.
entries.44ec9b97da28a316: Landowners who order construction of serviced housing for elderly people
entries.6670846efa6d2997: Elderly people certified as requiring nursing care and their families
entries.7063dcd2215940f0: Elderly people certified as requiring nursing care or support and their families
entries.ba33590c3506ff72: Under the name "Care Plan Center Enju," care managers create care plans for users. It mainly targets residents of "Anjes."
entries.bc14a7a48fa87663: Under the name "Visiting Nursing Station Rūche," this business handles end-of-life care and other services for residents of "Anjes." It resumed in 2023, and large facilities have attached offices.
entries.c7be0bded28ef436: Under the name "Anjes," this business provides status monitoring services (safety confirmation) and living consultation services, as well as housing and living support services and meals. Its main residents are people at around care levels 2 to 3, and it provides support up to end-of-life care.
entries.dd03b3121517379c: Under the name "Care Station Anjes," this business mainly provides meal, toileting, and bathing support and daily living assistance to residents of "Anjes." Staff of the housing also take on this role and provide 24-hour monitoring.
entries.e9408b9a6a924522: A company that operates "Anges," a serviced housing for the elderly, and provides nursing care services such as home-visit care and home-visit nursing.
